cr.name: Nano Ceramic
cr.tagline: Absorbs and disperses infrared heat without signal interference.
cr.principle: Nano-scale ceramic particles are distributed evenly to manage infrared heat without using metal.

pros.0: Low reflectivity and natural visibility by day or night
pros.1: Does not affect GPS, 4G/5G, or ETC tags
pros.2: Stable color with strong oxidation resistance

notes.0: The glass surface may feel slightly warm after prolonged sun exposure
notes.1: Performance depends on ceramic-particle density and manufacturing quality

recommendation.signal: Compatible with smart devices and GPS

rf.name: Heat-reflective Sputter
rf.tagline: Reflects solar heat outward to keep the glass surface cooler.
rf.principle: Multiple ultra-thin precious-metal layers are deposited in a vacuum to reflect thermal radiation.

pros.2: High mechanical durability and service life

notes.0: Slightly more reflective than pure Ceramic film
notes.1: Select a signal-optimized line for ETC and GPS compatibility

recommendation.windshield: RF50 or RF70 for a bright, clear windshield
recommendation.sideRear: RF15 or RF30 for stronger heat rejection
recommendation.signal: Premium FUJITEK variants are optimized to reduce signal impact

hb.name: Hybrid Ceramic
hb.tagline: Balances Ceramic material with a heat-reflective coating.
hb.principle: Nano Ceramic particles combine with an ultra-thin reflective layer to absorb and reflect heat together.

pros.0: Balanced heat rejection and optical visibility
pros.1: Reduces the load on vehicle air conditioning
pros.2: Strong performance at an accessible price point

notes.0: Correct installation is essential for long-term adhesion

recommendation.windshield: HB50 reduces glare while retaining clear visibility
recommendation.sideRear: HB15 or HB20 provides greater privacy
recommendation.signal: The structure is tuned to minimize GPS interference

film.technologyDescription: Metal sputtering deposits premium metallic layers onto the film surface. These layers reflect a large portion of infrared radiation back outside, reducing the amount of heat transferred into the vehicle.

film.infraredDescription: Premium material layers reflect much of the infrared radiation back outside, limiting heat transfer through the glass and keeping the cabin cooler.

sp50Cat.description: SP50 is a Multilayer Sputter window film for windshields, balancing brightness, heat rejection, and optical clarity.
introduction: Its multilayer sputtering structure helps control infrared radiation while preserving clear driver visibility.
A subtle blue tone creates a premium look for vehicles that need a bright windshield with clear heat reduction.
Electronic warranty support keeps warranty information transparent throughout use.
features: Rejects up to 98% infrared radiation to reduce windshield heat.
Blocks 99.9% UV to help protect occupants and interiors.
50.6% visible light transmission suits windshield visibility needs.
applications: Windshields for personal and premium service vehicles.
Customers who prioritize clarity and low reflection.
Vehicles frequently used in daytime or hot urban conditions.

6000K light color delivers a modern and easy-to-read beam.
features: Controlled cut-off when installed and adjusted correctly.
Suitable for many mainstream vehicle models.
applications: Fog-light or compact lighting upgrades.
Vehicles that need improved night visibility.

biledPro1.description: Laser Pro Fog Bi-LED is designed for strong lighting, water resistance, and stable operation in demanding weather.

applications: Vehicles frequently driven on highways, mountain roads, or bad weather.

auxLight1.description: Matrix Spot 40W auxiliary lights add long-range lighting for night trips, offroad use, and poorly lit roads.

features: Supports dark roads, rain, and fog.
applications: Pickup trucks, SUVs, and work vehicles.

general.title: GENERAL TERMS AND POLICIES
general.lead: By visiting the FUJITEK website, reviewing products, or using our automotive window-film and accessory services, customers agree to the following terms.

sections.heading: I. Payment
bullets: Customers may pay in cash after installation acceptance or accessory delivery.
Bank transfer and electronic payment instructions are available through customer support.

sections.heading: II. Shipping and delivery
bullets: Direct delivery and installation may be arranged near authorized FUJITEK service locations.
Accessories for other regions are delivered nationwide through established COD carriers.

sections.heading: III. Returns and warranty
bullets: Eligible warranty requests are normally processed within ten working days.
Qualifying films receive a 10- or 15-year electronic warranty depending on product range.
Manufacturing defects reported shortly after purchase may qualify for replacement.

sections.heading: IV. Information protection
bullets: Customer, vehicle, and electronic warranty data is protected and used only for service, support, and relevant customer care.

privacy.title: PRIVACY POLICY
privacy.lead: FUJITEK protects personal and vehicle information supplied for consultation, installation, and electronic warranty services.

sections.heading: 1. Information collected
bullets: Contact, account, vehicle, and warranty information needed to provide requested services.
Technical visit data such as IP address, browser type, language, and pages viewed.

sections.heading: 2. How information is used
bullets: To fulfill purchases, provide technical support, answer inquiries, and deliver opted-in service updates.

sections.heading: 3. Retention
bullets: Information is retained while required for customer service, warranty administration, or applicable legal obligations.

sections.heading: 4. Data controller
bullets: Vilatek Joint Stock Company manages customer information through its Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi offices.

sections.heading: 5. Access and correction
bullets: Customers may request access, correction, or deletion of their information through FUJITEK support channels.

sections.heading: 6. Security commitment
bullets: FUJITEK does not disclose personal information without authorization except where required by law.

purchasing.title: PURCHASING AND INSTALLATION BOOKING POLICY
purchasing.lead: FUJITEK supports direct, telephone, and online purchasing and installation booking throughout Vietnam.

sections.heading: 1. Product origin and certification
bullets: Qualifying products are supplied with origin and conformity documentation.
Window-film performance can be checked using dedicated measurement equipment.

sections.heading: 2. Ordering options
bullets: Customers may order through authorized dealers, the FUJITEK hotline, or the official website.

sections.heading: 3. Acceptance and electronic warranty activation
bullets: After installation, the vehicle glass is inspected with the customer before electronic warranty activation.

warrantyReturn.title: WARRANTY, RETURN, AND REFUND POLICY
warrantyReturn.lead: FUJITEK electronic warranty and return terms protect customers purchasing qualifying official products.

sections.heading: 1. Coverage and duration
bullets: Nano Ceramic L15 and L50 products receive a 10-year electronic warranty.
B55, B15, SP50, and SP10 products receive a 15-year electronic warranty for eligible manufacturing defects.
A valid WM-* warranty code is required.

sections.heading: 2. Exclusions
bullets: Damage caused by impact, accidents, misuse, harsh chemicals, unauthorized repair, or expired coverage is excluded.

sections.heading: 3. Returns and refunds
bullets: Products reported within the stated initial period may qualify when a verified manufacturing defect or incorrect supply is confirmed.

sections.heading: 4. Shipping and claims
bullets: Accessory shipping costs and claim handling follow the conditions communicated by customer support.

shipping.title: SHIPPING AND DELIVERY POLICY
shipping.lead: FUJITEK provides nationwide delivery for eligible website, social, telephone, and in-store orders.

sections.heading: 1. Method and estimated time
bullets: Accessories are delivered through established carriers, including COD where available.
Orders are normally confirmed within 24 hours and delivery commonly takes three to five days.

sections.heading: 2. Possible delays
bullets: Incorrect contact details, difficult addresses, demand spikes, weather, or carrier disruption may delay delivery.

sections.heading: 3. Fees and inspection
bullets: Shipping fees depend on destination and parcel size and are confirmed before dispatch.

sections.heading: 4. Geographic limitations
bullets: Large provincial or dealer orders may use specialist carriers under separately agreed commercial terms.

payment.title: PAYMENT POLICY
payment.lead: FUJITEK offers cash, COD, and bank-transfer options so customers can choose a suitable payment method.

sections.heading: 1. Cash payment
bullets: Cash payment is accepted at authorized locations after installation and vehicle handover.

sections.heading: 2. Cash on delivery
bullets: COD is available for many accessory orders delivered nationwide.

sections.heading: 3. Bank transfer
bullets: Customers may transfer payment to the official account confirmed by FUJITEK before delivery.

sections.heading: 4. Transfer notes
bullets: Transfer references should identify the customer and order. Wholesale arrangements follow the signed agreement.

filmLayers.title: Anatomy of 5 High-Tech Film Layers
filmLayers.instruction: Hover over layers to inspect detailed structure:

scratchCoat.title: Scratch Resistant Coating
scratchCoat.description: 2H hardness surface layer protecting against scratches during glass operation and cleaning.

sputterMetal.title: Sputter Metal Layer
sputterMetal.description: Utilizes precious metal atomic particles to reflect maximum solar infrared radiation.

opticalBase.title: Optical Base PET Film
opticalBase.description: Ultra-clear optical PET film ensuring crystal-clear night and rainy driving vision.

nanoCeramic.title: Nano Ceramic Thermal Layer
nanoCeramic.description: Nanometer-sized ceramic particles blocking heat-generating infrared spectrum.

adhesive.title: Pressure-Sensitive Adhesive (PSA)
adhesive.description: Odorless imported adhesive with extreme bond strength and zero air bubbles.

brandHeritage.row1Title: Redefining Premium Automotive Window Film Standards in Vietnam
brandHeritage.row1Desc1: Fujitek introduces a new generation of window films with a mission to set a distinct standard: not only rejecting heat, but elevating the driving experience in modern urban environments.
brandHeritage.row1Desc2: Developed and manufactured in Japan - the cradle of advanced Asian materials technology - Fujitek represents the crystallization of engineering performance, aesthetic design, and sustainable value.
brandHeritage.row2Title: Tech Origin – The Foundation of Trust
brandHeritage.row2Desc1: “Made in Japan” is not just an origin label; it is a quality promise. Fujitek is researched, manufactured, and inspected according to strict high-tech materials engineering standards.
brandHeritage.row2Desc2: In Vietnam, Fujitek is introduced as a long-term solution, catering to discerning customers who value real-world performance, technological durability, and premium driving comfort.

coreTech.title: Two Leading Tech Platforms
coreTech.subtitle: Discover the power of advanced Metal Sputtering and Nano Ceramic technology.

sputtering.title: Sputtering Technology
sputtering.description: Bombarding precious metal atoms (Titanium, Silver, Gold) onto PET film in high vacuum, creating a superior heat-reflecting layer while keeping film thin.
sputtering.b1: Superior reflective heat rejection up to 70% TSER
sputtering.b2: Natural tone, color-fast for over 10 years

nanoCeramic.title: Nano Ceramic Technology
nanoCeramic.description: Coating ultra-fine ceramic particles (<10nm) absorbing shortwave IR without interfering with GPS, 4G/5G, RFID, or VETC signals.
nanoCeramic.b1: 100% Zero interference with radio and car signals
nanoCeramic.b2: Night anti-glare and low interior reflection

pioneerTech.title: Pioneer Technology
pioneerTech.description: Continuously researching and applying the latest technologies from Japan to deliver superior heat rejection solutions.

japaneseQuality.title: Japanese Quality
japaneseQuality.description: 100% manufactured in Japan with strict quality control adhering to ISO 9001 standards.

dedicatedService.title: Dedicated Service
dedicatedService.description: Accompanying customers with 10-year warranty protection and nationwide dealer network coverage.

craftsmanship.description: All Fujitek window film products are manufactured on fully automated production lines meeting Japan's strict quality standards.

research.title: R&D Research
